comments.author: @gweneth5958
comments.text:
This is really genius. I am sure people would immediately believe that just one AI did that, at least the people who are not in the AI scene. 🤣 It will still take much time, especially with so many different AI's used, wow... I am not sure if I would have the patient for that, at least not at the moment... if I would get lost in something like that... no, no, I shouldn't think about it. 

And suno... wow, this made me so happy. I would have never thought it would have such a great effect on me... I created the first song and... I cried, no joke. I LOVE music, but I don't think that I am skilled enough to write my own sheet music, maybe with loooots of work and much more time put into it... But I have so many on my plate, if I'd started that too... I had to skip sleeping for years. It took me some trying and checking suno out, but eventually it got better and better, added Violin solos and... I have a playlist for sports now, or I added them to the list. I am so impressed and I love it. And I think it will just get better =) And I had some pieces... they sounded real, like... really, really authentic. It wasn't my style at all (tried different styles) but the sound and the voice was MOST impressive. So, sometimes it just takes more tries, absolutely love it!

comments.author: @justindressler5992
comments.text:
Considering one guy did this it's pretty impressive. We are still only in the vary early days of this technology imagine were things will be in a couple more years. I mean just look at the progress of Sora. I recently seen an app that wrote the lyrics background music and vocals from a single text prompt. So the technology is accelerating quickly. I'm not sure what the implications of all this change will be. Will society in the future listen to AI sound tracks created as pop music. Like we listen to the same churn of human created pop music. Possibly since no one really cares about pop music just flash in the pan stuff to listen too in the background. But who will be making the money especially if the artist who create this material can't claim copyright to AI content.

It might end up being fenced off so only the corporation will be given access to it. No longer needed artist or producers or anything just an algorithm that generates a new rap/pop song every couple of days. Then published on corporate owned digital media networks. I think it is beginning to be obvious that we need to consider the possible future reality here. Not from an angle of how we control it but how do we live with it.
